sources.label: Beyonder Morphe patches
sources.author: Beyonder
patch_list: Makes Firebase App Check's Play Integrity token fetch succeed with a throwaway token, so the app no longer reports "Device integrity can't be verified". The server still rejects the token, so AI food search keeps failing there. Client-side…
Unlocks all premium features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a re-signed sideload will not work.
